_about: Camera block: side (tripod beside the table, static, 60 degree lens).
temporal_caption: At 0:00 a static side view of the wooden table: the white robot arm stands on the left, reaching right and holding the light-blue pitcher in the air; the clear empty glass stands in the middle of the table; behind is the back wall with a white cabinet and a shelf of jars. From 0:00 to 0:01 the arm carries the pitcher over the glass. From 0:01 to 0:02 it tilts the pitcher toward the camera. From 0:02 to 0:05 a thin stream of water falls from the lip into the glass and the water level rises. From 0:05 to 0:06 the pitcher tilts back upright and the stream stops. From 0:06 to 0:07 the arm moves the pitcher back to the right.

aesthetics.composition: Table across the lower half of the frame, the robot on the left, the glass in the centre

cinematography.framing: Medium-wide shot of the table and robot
cinematography.camera_angle: Slightly above table height, from the side
cinematography.focus: The robot, pitcher and glass in focus
